examples.title: From the bottom
examples.description: A short panel that comes up from the bottom edge.

a11y: It's a modal <dialog>, so it works like Dialog: focus stays inside, Escape closes it, focus goes back to the trigger.
A click on the dimmed page closes it.
In right-to-left pages the right sheet comes from the left, and the other way round.
With reduced motion, it fades in instead of sliding.
